Build the data_subplot_feat rows for new observation features

dot-upd_obs_feature_rows.Rd

One row per value. A people feature takes several person ids at once; every other type takes one value. Values that are blank, or already recorded for the same subplot and type, are dropped.

Usage

.upd_obs_feature_rows(
  id_sub_plots,
  id_type,
  valuetype,
  values,
  existing = NULL
)

Arguments

id_sub_plots

Integer(1). The subplot record being described.

id_type

Integer(1). `subplotype_list.id_subplotype` of the feature.

valuetype

Character(1). `subplotype_list.valuetype` of the feature.

values

Vector of values (person ids for a people feature).

existing

Data frame of the observation features already recorded, with `id_sub_plots`, `id_type_sub_plot`, `typevalue`, `typevalue_char`.

Value

A data frame ready for `data_subplot_feat`, zero rows if nothing is left to add. Stops on a value a numeric type cannot hold.

Details

The value goes where the feature wizard and `add_subplot_features()` put it: `typevalue` for `numeric`, `integer` and `table_colnam` types (the person id is a number), `typevalue_char` for the others.
